title: crs's stone tool obliteration
description: this removed all stone tools and replaces the next step in progression with copper.
body:
i saw that after like, 2 months of the copper age bein out, there was no pack that made copper the next stage in progression after wood and make stone tools uncraftable, so i decided to do it myself, i took the time to completelly obliterate all stone tools cause they stink like poo poo.

enjoy.
